sources.title: Voice Models - docs.aihub.gg
sources.snippet: What is a Voice Model In the field of AI, is a program that was trained to recognize certain patterns or make certain decisions. In this case, voice models are models trained to replicate a voice, and with AI they apply it to the input audio. There are plenty of them uploaded to the internet, made by the public.
